findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_company_documents, get_market_cap_history, get_ipos · Private data: submit_dalalos_feedback, get_financials, get_brsr, get_stock_events, get_company_documents, get_price_band_hits, get_market_breadth · Public sink: submit_dalalos_feedback, get_financials, get_price_history, get_dividends, get_relevant_peers, get_ipos, estimate_index_flow · Destructive: remove_from_watchlist, list_preset_screens, run_preset_screen, list_index_events.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_company_documents, get_market_cap_history, get_ipos · Private data: submit_dalalos_feedback, get_financials, get_brsr, get_stock_events, get_company_documents, get_price_band_hits, get_market_breadth · Public sink: submit_dalalos_feedback, get_financials, get_price_history, get_dividends, get_relevant_peers, get_ipos, estimate_index_flow · Destructive: remove_from_watchlist, list_preset_screens, run_preset_screen, list_index_events

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
